idea-plugin.name: Jenkins Builds
idea-plugin.description:
A Jenkins client in a tool window: browse jobs, start and stop builds, read build details and the console log.

  • Connection that works with corporate servers: preemptive Basic authentication with a password or an API token, CSRF crumbs, the IDE proxy settings and the IDE certificate dialog for self-signed certificates
  • The password or token is kept in the IDE password store, the address and user name in the IDE settings
  • Test Connection reports the HTTP status and the answer of the server
  • Jobs grouped the way Jenkins shows them: views, sections, folders and multibranch projects, with status and last build
  • Build list of a job: number, display name, result, start time, duration, who started it
  • Build with parameters: text, boolean, choice, password and branch selectors (Git Parameter) with a searchable list of values
  • Stop a running build, cancel a queued one, rebuild with the same parameters
  • Build details: causes, parameters, Git revision and branch, changes, test summary, artifacts with download, and a console log that follows a running build

Open View | Tool Windows | Jenkins Builds and set up the server in Settings | Tools | Jenkins Builds.
